game_concept: A action defense set in Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden, a garden growing near vents: the fire warden must handle smoke serpents while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Modulo Gate: Use % to decide which gates in Vent Garden open (even, odd, divisible by 3).
theme: Mt. Pyre – Vent Garden: a garden growing near vents
core_gameplay_loop: In Vent Garden, repeat each round: Use % to decide which gates in Vent Garden open (even, odd, divisible by 3). Each round, smoke serpents strike the ash barrier, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the gates_open value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the ash barrier from smoke serpents in Vent Garden: keep the gates_open meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 50-second timer ends.
controls: Mouse/touch: drag code blocks into the editor panel; SPACE runs the code; keys 1-4 pick answers.
lose_condition: gates_open drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 50-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 3 (intro tier): Modulo Gate
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Modulo Gate' (Week 2 slot 3), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Vent Garden'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how gates_open changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against smoke serpents in Vent Garden.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 50 seconds while gates_open > 0.
